status: Draft revision 3 — pending final user approval; not implemented
scope: Merge remaining same-label catalogue rows. Anti-Regeneration II and Physical Cleave II adopt the stronger parameters. Lightning III uses one chain shape while preserving each owner damage channel. Bonded Formation keeps exact owner-specific partners in a single display row. Other meaningful configurations are grouped in the UI without unrequested combat changes.

policy.levels: One global scalar potency ladder per family, independent of faction, engine and assignment order. Same potency shares a Roman level. Different radius, targeting, trigger or critical inheritance remains an explicit profile qualifier, never a hidden duplicate level.
policy.human: Only explicitly listed shared ability buffs are proposed. Human recipes, primary combat stats and unrelated abilities remain fixed. Shared Lady Claire combat and ingredients are preserved.
policy.matching: Exact equivalent effects collapse. The explicit restrained near-value table below promotes toward the stronger existing anchor; it never rounds downward or transitively clusters across broad gaps. Flame Cone, Heat, Visibility, Stun and Sky Hunt have separately justified explicit requested changes.
policy.numbering: Levels are contiguous except two explicit user anchors. Armor Reduction keeps 40=VIII and retires VII; Attack Speed Aura merges 10I/20II into20I, retiresII and retains70=VII. activeLevelNumbers and levelSpan describe these two deliberate gaps; no empty rows are displayed.
policy.sameLevelVariants: Magical Cleave, Slow and Slow Aura select their existing dominant whole configuration at each potency. Area, duration and scope do not regress.
policy.ricochet: Crits and ordinary on-hit effects are enabled. Bounce distance is unrestricted; finite distinct targets and an ancestor-proc guard prevent recursive event cycles.
policy.displayLevels: Render one row per full ability-level label. Necessary mode/range distinctions belong inside that row, not repeated identical level headings.
policy.bondedFormation: The common +20% level preserves all 14 exact mutual pairs; never union partner lists across owners.
policy.lightningIII: 20% chance,250 damage,5 additional targets,6-tile links,sequential chain. Damage type profile resolves to each owner existing Holy or Magical channel. Explicit distinct targets preserves the existing no-repeat chain contract.
policy.claire: Effective combat stays exact. The III Holy-to-profile alias and explicit distinct flag are metadata normalization, with an assignment-level equivalence proof.

retiredLevels.reason: 35 armor was promoted to 40 armor; explicit Armor Reduction VIII identity is preserved.
The former 10% I and 20% II are one 20% I effect. Explicit 70% VII identity is preserved.
